# Miljötillståndsrisker

Public, read-only Swedish dataset covering risks in the Swedish environmental permitting process.

Each risk event contains 3-5 possible trigger factors and 3-5 possible consequences. Every item distinguishes a source-grounded premise (`source`) from analytical risk inference (`analysis`); the source label does not claim that the complete causal chain is empirically proven.

- Web app: https://nic-esp.github.io/miljotillstandsrisker/
- AI access guide: https://nic-esp.github.io/miljotillstandsrisker/ai-access.html
- Remote MCP (Streamable HTTP, no authentication): https://miljotillstandsrisker-mcp.fantastic-pea.workers.dev/mcp
- MCP health: https://miljotillstandsrisker-mcp.fantastic-pea.workers.dev/health

## Complete public data

- 342 complete risk records: https://nic-esp.github.io/miljotillstandsrisker/data/riskregister.json
- 342 complete risk records (CSV; one row per risk with a causes-event-effects `bow_tie_json` cell): https://nic-esp.github.io/miljotillstandsrisker/data/riskregister.csv
- Normalized trigger/consequence rows (CSV): https://nic-esp.github.io/miljotillstandsrisker/data/riskregister-items.csv
- Exploration model (JSON; source controls, analytical shared controls, exact and semantic cause/effect groups, explicit targets and provenance): https://nic-esp.github.io/miljotillstandsrisker/data/exploration.json
- Controls (CSV; risk IDs, source excerpts and explicit target relationships): https://nic-esp.github.io/miljotillstandsrisker/data/controls.csv
- 160 risk-mappable nodes: https://nic-esp.github.io/miljotillstandsrisker/data/nodes.json
- Source registry: https://nic-esp.github.io/miljotillstandsrisker/data/sources.json
- Process charts B00-B70: https://nic-esp.github.io/miljotillstandsrisker/data/process-charts.json

The original risk, node, source and process JSON files, riskregister.csv and riskregister-items.csv are also available on the MCP host under /data/. The new exploration.json and controls.csv are static GitHub Pages downloads only; the MCP tools and API contract are unchanged. A single risk is available at /api/risks/{risk_id}.

## Interpreting exploration relationships

Each source control preserves a risk's original mitigation text. Shared controls and semantic cause/effect groups are analytical groupings with explicit rationales and source excerpts; they have not been recorded as independently reviewed. Exact-text groups indicate matching wording, not demonstrated causal dependence. Individual occurrences retain their own source or analysis status.

Control targets identify specific causes, risk events or consequences. Similarity-group membership never extends a control's target coverage. A link does not establish implementation, effectiveness, residual probability or statistical dependence. Source references attached to a control provide the surrounding risk's source context, not measured evidence of mitigation performance.

The BTL ranking is relative. Connected-risk counts describe the dataset's documented reach; they are not calibrated occurrence probabilities, risk reduction estimates or a universal control-priority score. Visitors can investigate published data but cannot edit it.

## MCP retrieval

Use `search` followed by `fetch` for cited retrieval. To retrieve every complete risk record without oversized tool responses, call `get_dataset_page` with `limit: 25`, then follow `next_cursor` until it is null. Other read-only tools expose nodes, sources, statistics, and complete process charts.

ChatGPT does not auto-discover a public MCP URL. Create the connection in Developer mode, then add that connection to a new conversation from the Tools menu.
